question: Big storm Saturday night, the street gullies couldnt cope and rainwater came in under the front door. Ground floor carpets and kitchen units ruined, £9k, excess £350. Storm claim - what do we pay?

app_answer.answer: The storm-driven rain that entered through the front door caused damage to the carpets and kitchen units, which falls under the storm coverage. After applying the policy excess of £350, the payable amount is £8,650.

excluding_clause: 4.2b Flood exclusion — water entering from outside via surface run-off / overflowing drains (street gullies backing up, rain coming in under an undamaged door) is flood, payout modifier 0 without flood rider. 4.2a storm only covers storm-driven rain entering through damage caused by the storm itself. BM25 retrieval returned 4.2a/1.2/1.1 and missed 4.2b, so the model paid it under storm.
